walkthroughs.body_html:

Reverse field -> also reverses.
Coil in magnetic field; split ring keeps it spinning one way.

mcqs.q: What produces a magnetic field around a wire?
options: The net force equals the velocity times the mass of the object.
The metal in the wire is naturally magnetic.
A moving electric charge — i.e. an electric current.
The voltage across the wire creates magnetism.

mcqs.q: If an object is moving at constant velocity in a straight line, what is the net force on it?
options: There must be a forward force on the object to keep it moving.
The voltage across the wire creates magnetism.
Zero — by Newton's first law, constant velocity requires zero net force.
The net force equals the velocity times the mass of the object.

mcqs.q: What happens to the current as it goes around a series circuit?
options: Current gets used up by each component as it flows around the circuit.
Current splits in half at the battery so each direction gets some.
It stays the same at every point — current is conserved.
The net force equals the velocity times the mass of the object.
